verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a downloadable OpenAPI spec or equivalent machine-readable spec. The API reference page only describes Postman as a third-party tool and does not state that Mercado Pago publishes a downloadable collection or spec. The MCP server and CLI are separate agent-facing features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
